title: JsonWebKey
description: One JSON Web Key as served by the JWKS endpoint, derived from identity_oidc::jwt::JsonWebKey. The `use` field is the load-bearing rename: the Rust field is `use_` because `use` is a Rust keyword, and it carries #[serde(rename = "use")]. A client that received "use_" instead of "use" would not find the key's usage at all — which is why the crate has a test asserting the serialised form contains "use" and does not contain "use_".
x-serde-status: the type is IMPLEMENTED as a shape; the JWKS endpoint is DEFERRED to phase 4 (OIDC provider) and there is no signing key yet, so no document with a real key exists

kty.description: The key type. RSA only in bootstrap — JsonWebKey::KEY_TYPE.

x-accepted-values.constraining: the field is a String in Rust

use.description: The intended use of the key: 'sig' and never 'enc'. This provider does not encrypt with its signing keys, and a key advertised for both is a key someone will eventually use for both. JsonWebKey::USE_SIGNATURE is the only accepted use.

x-rename.reason: `use` is a Rust keyword, so the field is `use_` and the rename puts the RFC 7517 name back on the wire.
x-rename.test: identity_oidc::jwt::tests::the_use_field_serialises_as_use asserts the body contains "use":"sig" and does not contain "use_"

x-accepted-values.constraining: the field is a String in Rust

alg.description: The intended algorithm of the key. Matches kty. RS256 only — the discovery document advertises id_token_signing_alg_values_supported == ["RS256"] and userinfo_signing_alg_values_supported == ["RS256"], and neither JwtHeader::ALGORITHM nor JwtHeader::ACCEPTED_ALGORITHM names anything else.

x-accepted-values.constraining: the field is a String in Rust; the two constants are deliberately distinct so a future second algorithm cannot widen what is accepted

kid.description: The key identifier, referenced by a JWT header's kid. JwkSet::find looks a key up by this value, and an absent kid is a verification failure rather than a reason to try another key.

n.description: The RSA modulus, base64url without padding. A public value.

e.description: The RSA public exponent, base64url without padding. A public value.
